offering_description.value: Operates a corn-based ethanol plant in Lamberton, Minnesota. Produces fuel ethanol, distillers grains and corn oil from locally sourced corn. Sells these to fuel blenders, livestock feeders and industrial buyers through marketing agents.

primary_products.value: fuel ethanol; distillers grains; corn oil

customer_segment.value: B2B: fuel blenders, petroleum refiners, livestock feeders, feed distributors, biodiesel producers

end_markets.value: transportation fuel; animal feed; renewable fuels

revenue_model.value: product sales: ethanol, distillers grains and corn oil sold via marketing agreements

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: processes purchased corn into ethanol and co-products, sold to marketers and end users

geography_served.value: US national: Plant in southwest Minnesota, products shipped by rail and truck across the US, with some exports through marketers

specialization.value: related lines: ethanol and its co-products: distillers grains and corn oil from a single plant

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: third-party marketing firms sell ethanol, distillers grains and corn oil

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Environmental permits (EPA, Minnesota PCA) and federal Renewable Fuel Standard and fuel policy affect demand and operations

notes: Marketing agent details and export extent are from general knowledge and may be imprecise.
